summary: Configured zram-backed compressed swap on node1 (CentOS Stream 10): installed zram-generator, set /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf for zram0 with zram-size=512 (512MB), compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100. Confirmed it activates automatically at boot after a full node restart, with no competing disk-backed swap present.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: CentOS Stream 10, systemd 257, no existing swap, zram-generator not installed
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf defining zram0 with 512MB size, zstd compression, swap-priority 100
Reloaded systemd and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service; verified swapon shows 512M zram0 active at priority 100
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, swap state, zram sysfs values, config file contents
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed from d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9 to e62f565a-df4a-4aa9-a527-eda780eb47eb
Post-restart verification: zram0 swap active automatically (512M, zstd, priority 100), systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service ran cleanly at boot, config file intact, no disk-backed swap present

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory (zram) swap configured, active
evidence.summary: zram-generator installed; /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf created with zram-size=512, compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100; swapon --show confirms 512M zram0 device active with zstd algorithm in /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm

evidence.requirement: Swap preferred over any disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: Baseline showed zero disk swap present (swapon --show empty); after configuration only zram0 exists at priority 100, so zram is the exclusive and therefore preferred swap device both immediately and after reboot

Captured pre-restart boot_id (d052eb57...) and healthy zram swap state, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id (e62f565a...) proving an actual restart occurred, then verified systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service auto-ran at boot and swapon shows the same 512M zstd zram0 device active with no manual intervention
